name: claude-mods
description: Function-hooks mods (bands, panes) for Claude Code

plugins.name: meter
plugins.description: Session meters: a band above the prompt on desktop, a status line under the prompt on the terminal, and a subagent line while a subagent's transcript is in view

plugins.name: agent-graph
plugins.description: Pane drawing the session's running subagents: a left-to-right card graph in the desktop app, an indented tree in the terminal
